description: Consumer find/replace source for theming Phase 2b: the JS theming path is removed and themes are static CSS classes. Companion to token-rename-map.json (Phases 1 + 2a, which renamed the CSS custom properties). Apply this map AFTER token-rename-map.json. Every row was verified against the regenerated api.md files: 'umbrella' = packages/react-components/react-components/etc/react-components.api.md, 'tokens' = packages/tokens/etc/tokens.api.md.
prerequisite: Import '@fluentui/react-tailwind-theme/styles.css' exactly once per document. It emits the Web Light token values at ':root, :host' (so the default theme needs no provider and no class) and ships one class per theme.

propRenames.note: A nested provider that omits themeClassName inherits the parent provider's resolved class.

relocatedToTokens.note: Removed from @fluentui/react-components and @fluentui/react-theme; still exported by @fluentui/tokens, but as BUILD-TIME / TOOLING input only — not part of the runtime API. Use them in a script to generate a theme class, then ship that class as static CSS.

removedNoReplacement.reason: The provider no longer builds a theme rule at runtime; theme rules are generated at build time by @fluentui/react-tailwind-theme.
removedNoReplacement.guidance: Author the theme as a CSS class of custom-property declarations (canonical kebab-case names) and ship it as static CSS.

removedNoReplacement.reason: The runtime theme <style> tag is deleted.
removedNoReplacement.guidance: None needed — apply a theme class instead.

removedNoReplacement.reason: FluentProvider no longer provides a JS theme object at runtime.
removedNoReplacement.guidance: To read a resolved token VALUE at runtime, use useCssVarValue (@fluentui/react-utilities) at an element inside the themed scope, passing the active theme class via its `deps` option so a theme switch re-reads.

removedNoReplacement.reason: There is no runtime or SSR style element left to sign (DECISIONS.md D20.1 retired).
removedNoReplacement.guidance: Cover the static .css assets with a CSP `style-src` source list. `style-src 'unsafe-inline'` is not required.
